formula: sqrt(2*s2*log(4*M/alpha)/N)+7*range_width*log(4*M/alpha)/(3*(N-1)); s2 unbiased sample variance. Conditional on independent frozen pilot, fixed IID main draws.
scope_limit: Uniform scores, one positive and constant unit costs only. No inference for nonuniform learned scores, real costs or formal training. Preserve INCONCLUSIVE_PRECISION without sample extensions.
